blocks.en: Seoul National University College of Engineering: Plan for Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Training

□ Background ㅇ Through completing the Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Training, College of Engineering students build a safety net to protect lives, based on a correct understanding and knowledge of suicide ㅇ Since the 2016 academic year, completing the Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Training has been mandatory for new College of Engineering students (undergraduate and graduate programs)
blocks.ko: □ 추진 배경 ㅇ 생명존중(자살예방)교육 이수를 통해 공과대학 학생 스스로 자살에 대한 올바른 이해와 지식을 바탕으로 생명을 보호할 수 있는 안전망 마련 ㅇ 2016학년도부터 공과대학 신입생(학사과정, 대학원 과정) 생명존중(자살예방) 교육 이수 의무화

blocks.en: - 「Enforcement Rules on Graduation Completion Requirements for Undergraduate Programs, College of Engineering, Seoul National University」 revised and promulgated (4 Sep 2019)

- 「Enforcement Guidelines on the Foreign Language Exam and Comprehensive Exam for Thesis Submission Eligibility in Graduate Programs, College of Engineering, Seoul National University」 revised and promulgated (10 Nov 2021)
blocks.ko: - 「서울대학교 공과대학 대학원 논문제출자격 외국어시험 및 종합시험에 관한 시행 지침」개정․공포(2021.11.10.)

blocks.en: □ Implementation Plan ㅇ (Target) New students and transfer students (신(편)입생) in undergraduate and graduate programs of the College of Engineering
blocks.ko: □ 추진 계획 ㅇ (교육대상) 공과대학 학사과정 및 대학원과정 신(편)입생

blocks.ko: ※ 2016학년도 신입생부터 의무화, 기존 재학생은 이수 권고

blocks.en: - Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Training is provided to undergraduate and graduate students using the ‘보고듣고말하기 교육’ ("See, Listen, Talk" training) program of the 중앙자살예방센터 (Korea Suicide Prevention Center, under the Ministry of Health and Welfare)
blocks.ko: - 중앙자살예방센터(보건복지부 산하) ‘보고듣고말하기 교육’프로그램을 활용하여 학사과정 및 대학원과정 학생들에게 생명존중(자살예방)교육 제공

blocks.en: - Training content ⦁ Introduction: the current situation and seriousness of suicide ⦁ See: look for verbal, behavioral and situational signs that suggest suicide. ⦁ Listen: ask directly about suicidal thoughts and actively listen to the person's reasons for dying and reasons for living. ⦁ Talk: check the safety checklist and refer the person to a professional for help. ⦁ Wrap-up
blocks.ko: - 교육내용 ⦁ 도입 : 자살의 현황 및 심각성 ⦁ 보기 : 자살을 암시하는 언어, 행동, 상황적 신호를 본다. ⦁ 듣기 : 실제 자살 생각을 묻고 죽음의 이유와 삶의 이유를 적극적으로 듣는다. ⦁ 말하기 : 안전점검목록을 확인하고 전문가에게 도움을 의뢰한다. ⦁ 정리

blocks.en: Course title / Enrollment period / Training time
Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Training (Round 1) 24 Aug 2026 (Mon) ~ 7 Sep 2026 (Mon) 60 min: See, Listen, Talk Training (Round 2) 28 Oct 2026 (Wed) ~ 27 Nov 2026 (Fri)

- How to apply: Log in to SNU eTL > SNUON > 강좌목록 (Course List) > click ‘[공과대학]생명존중(자살예방)교육’ ([College of Engineering] Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Training) > 수강신청 (enroll) and 강의실 이동 (go to classroom) > watch the ‘생명존중(자살예방)교육’ (Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Training) video
blocks.ko: - 신청방법: SNU eTL 접속 > SNUON > 강좌목록 > ‘[공과대학]생명존중(자살예방)교육’ 클릭 > 수강신청 및 강의실 이동 > ‘생명존중(자살예방)교육’ 영상 시청

blocks.en: - 1 - ⦁ You can apply for and complete the training at any time within the enrollment period ⦁ You must watch at least 80% of the video before you can take the quiz ⦁ Completing the quiz → completion requirement met (a certificate of completion can be issued regardless of your score, but you must answer all questions) ★ Issuing the certificate of completion: available immediately after completion. eTL > 'My Menu (your name)' at the top right > 비정규 강좌 수강 (Non-regular Courses) > 진행중/종료 (In progress/Completed) > click ‘이수증 발급’ (Issue Certificate of Completion) to the right of [공과대학]생명존중(자살예방)교육 ([College of Engineering] Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Training)
blocks.ko: - 1 - ⦁ 수강기간 내 실시간 교육신청 및 이수 가능 ⦁ 동영상 80%이상 필수 시청 이후 퀴즈 응시 가능 ⦁ 퀴즈 응시 완료 → 이수 조건 충족 (점수에 상관없이 교육 이수증 발급 가능하나 전 문항 응시해야 함) ★ 이수증 발급 : 이수 즉시 발급 가능 eTL >우측상단 'My Menu(이름)' > 비정규 강좌 수강 > 진행중/종료 > [공과대학]생명존중(자살예방)교육 우측 ‘이수증 발급'

blocks.en: □ Expected Effects ㅇ A correct understanding of the value of life and of bioethics awareness, and wider awareness of respect for life ㅇ Through the Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Training, students act as gatekeepers who protect lives, and a suicide prevention infrastructure is built through cooperation with the local community
blocks.ko: □ 기대효과 ㅇ 생명의 소중함과 생명윤리의식에 대한 올바른 이해 및 생명존중에 대한 인식 확산 ㅇ 생명존중(자살예방) 교육을 통하여 생명지킴이 역할을 수행하고, 지역사회와의 협력을 통한 자살 예방 인프라 구축

blocks.en: □ Notes ㅇ If you do not complete the training within the enrollment period, no additional enrollment will be allowed as an exception ㅇ Please observe the enrollment period and the certificate issuance period
blocks.ko: □ 유의사항 ㅇ 수강기간 내 미이수시 예외적인 추가 수강 불가 ㅇ 수강기간 및 이수증 발급 기간 준수 요망

english: The Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year will be held as described below. All students who are required to take it should complete the course.
가. Purpose: Through Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education, students gain a correct understanding of and knowledge about suicide, so they can help protect lives. This builds a safety net.
나. Who must take it: All new and transfer students (신(편)입생) in undergraduate and graduate programs of the College of Engineering who entered in the 2016 academic year or later

다. How to take the course: Log in to SNU eTL (online learning system) → 강좌목록 (Course List) → register for and take "[공과대학]생명존중(자살예방)교육" ([College of Engineering] Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education)
라. Course period: (1st round) 24 Aug 2026 (Mon) – 7 Sep 2026 (Mon) / (2nd round) 28 Oct 2026 (Wed) – 27 Nov 2026 (Fri)
※ If you do not complete the course within the course period, you cannot take it later as an exception.
1) Watch at least 80% of the video lectures, then take the quiz.
2) eTL → 'My Menu (your name)' at the top right → 비정규 강좌 수강 (Non-regular Courses) → 진행중/종료 (In Progress/Completed) → 이수증 발급 (Issue Certificate of Completion)
3) When it is issued: You can get the certificate immediately after you complete the course.
